property_summary: For any admissible (blockNumber, timestamp) pair, a 10-ether fallback call from a counterparty that reverts on receiving ether succeeds exactly when block.number % 15 != 0 (C pays out only on divisible blocks, so its failing transfer reverts the call there); the mutant pays on non-divisible blocks, so the success/revert pattern is inverted and the rule fails for some fuzzed block.
change_summary: Invert the payout condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0.
